dominant_question: Can a designed artefact address a bounded problem?
minimum_evidence: Requirements, rationale, accepted tests and evaluation criteria.
prohibited_inference: Local demonstration becomes production or institutional readiness
worked_example_title: Traceable validation and recovery in a bounded file-submission prototype

dominant_question: How does a method or system behave under declared conditions?
minimum_evidence: Formal assumptions, scenarios, comparator and sensitivity analysis.
prohibited_inference: One dataset, parameter setting or machine becomes universal superiority or model truth
worked_example_title: Sensitivity of API admission-control policies under bursty synthetic workloads

dominant_question: How well does a model predict under a locked validation protocol?
minimum_evidence: Provenance, split logic, baseline, metrics and error analysis.
prohibited_inference: Best metric becomes universal superiority, fairness or deployment value
worked_example_title: Transparent routing of service requests using a bounded text-classification baseline

dominant_question: What distribution, association or effect is supported by observed data?
minimum_evidence: Constructs, sampling, protocol, uncertainty and validity threats.
prohibited_inference: Threshold crossing becomes importance, causality or generalisability
worked_example_title: Effect of a structured debugging checklist in a bounded laboratory exercise

dominant_question: How do participants experience or make sense of a phenomenon?
minimum_evidence: Sampling rationale, protocol, reflexive analysis and traceable interpretation.
prohibited_inference: Recurring theme becomes population prevalence or universal truth
worked_example_title: How novice data analysts describe uncertainty when debugging notebook outputs

dominant_question: How and why does a bounded phenomenon unfold in context?
minimum_evidence: Case boundary, multiple evidence sources and a chain of evidence.
prohibited_inference: One bounded case becomes general prevalence or universal mechanism
worked_example_title: Adoption of automated dependency scanning in one university software laboratory

dominant_question: What does a documented corpus support?
minimum_evidence: Protocol, reproducible search, study identity, appraisal and synthesis.
prohibited_inference: Number of favourable publications becomes consensus or universal effectiveness
worked_example_title: Evidence synthesis of automated feedback for introductory programming exercises

dominant_question: Why must two routes answer one joint question together?
minimum_evidence: Dominant logic, integration point, adequate resources and both evidence contracts.
prohibited_inference: More methods become automatic mutual validation
worked_example_title: Accessibility and response performance of a campus event-notification prototype
